svg.aria-label: Left: the force on D in its frame, for q = 1 and z = 9/20: the unit force (sin q, cos q) of (D.6), then (0, -1) of (D.9), whose sum is the chord of the unit circle from (0, 1) to (sin q, cos q), then (z, 0) of (D.1); the total force F in orange. Right: the second derivative of the chord term for the largest weights L* and M* (purple) and for the weight 3/8 (blue) on [1/2, 5/3], below the envelope 3/40 - (3/10) min(q, 1) and the level -19/100, with the Taylor bounds at the five points of Table D.2 as dots
